title: Synthesis and editing of multi-instrument audio mixtures using scalar-quantised latents with MIDI Span conditioning
abstract: arXiv:2609.25546v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Music creation often involves iterative refinement, changing selected musical details while retaining the rest. To support such refinement, we introduce SpanSynth-Edit, a flow-matching model for MIDI-guided synthesis and editing of multi-instrument audio mixtures using low-frame-rate scalar-quantised latents. MIDI Span encodes instrument-labelled note lifecycles as unordered event sets with continuous-valued attributes and pools each set into one conditioning vector per audio-latent frame. The model uses contextual audio for instrument-specific timbre guidance and supports editing by resynthesising the target region from revised MIDI. Experiments on single- and multi-instrument benchmarks show competitive performance and demonstrate within-frame onset control. We also discuss limitations of transcription-based note-adherence evaluation.

translated_title: 使用标量量化潜在表示与MIDI Span条件控制的多乐器音频混合合成与编辑
translated_abstract: 音乐创作通常涉及迭代式的精细修改，即在保留其余部分的同时改变选定的音乐细节。为支持这种精细修改，我们提出了SpanSynth-Edit，一个基于流匹配的模型，使用低帧率标量量化潜在表示，实现MIDI引导的多乐器音频混合的合成与编辑。MIDI Span将带有乐器标签的音符生命周期编码为具有连续值属性的无序事件集合，并将每个集合池化为每个音频潜在帧对应的一个条件向量。该模型利用上下文音频提供特定乐器的音色引导，并支持通过根据修改后的MIDI重新合成目标区域来进行编辑。在单乐器和多乐器基准测试上的实验显示出具有竞争力的性能，并展示了帧内的起音控制能力。我们还讨论了基于转录的音符一致性评估方法的局限性。
tldr: 提出了SpanSynth-Edit，一个基于流匹配的模型，利用低帧率标量量化潜在表示和MIDI Span条件编码机制，实现MIDI引导的多乐器音频混合的合成与精细编辑。
en_tdlr: SpanSynth-Edit is a flow-matching model that uses low-frame-rate scalar-quantised latents and MIDI Span conditioning to enable MIDI-guided synthesis and editing of multi-instrument audio mixtures.
